summary: Google signs a 20-year deal for 890 MW of new capacity from uprates at 11 Constellation nuclear units, the first due by 2028, plus a 15-year agreement for 2,700 MW of existing PJM supply. No value stated.
notes: Constellation says the deal enables more than $4.3B of its own investment in the uprates; that is not the contract value, so no amount is stored. The 15-year, 2,700 MW agreement (a financial energy load following agreement in the 8-K) was signed and announced with the 20-year PPA, so both are one edge under D09; term_years gives the longer term. A five-year Google Cloud technology alliance announced the same day states no amount or direction and is not stored.
